name: catalogo-blucher
description: Search Editora Blucher's book catalog: current editions, prices in BRL, availability, tables of contents and syllabus reading lists.

interface.longDescription:
Catálogo Blucher connects ChatGPT to the book catalog of Editora Blucher, a Brazilian publisher of technical, scientific and academic books (engineering, psychoanalysis, sciences, mathematics, design and humanities). Instead of guessing or repeating outdated listings, ChatGPT looks the books up in the publisher's own catalog.

What you can do:
- Find Blucher books by topic, title, author or ISBN, in Portuguese or English, even with typos.
- Check a book's current edition, price in Brazilian reais (BRL), availability on Blucher's website, synopsis, table of contents and chapters.
- Find out whether an ISBN belongs to an older edition and which edition replaced it.
- Turn a course syllabus into a reading list: the books and chapters that cover each topic, the core books, and the topics the catalog does not cover.
- See which subject areas, series, languages and formats exist in the catalog.

Who it is for: students, teachers and course coordinators building reading lists, librarians, booksellers and readers looking for Blucher titles.

How it works: the plugin is read-only and needs no sign-in. Book data is the same as on the public book pages at www.blucher.com.br and is refreshed daily. Each answer links to the book's page on Blucher's website.

Limitations: it covers only Editora Blucher's catalog, and most books are in Portuguese. It does not sell books, take payments or place orders; prices and availability on the website prevail at checkout, and purchases happen only there. E-books are sold through third-party digital stores, which the plugin does not link to. Open-access books link to their open-access full text. Syllabus matching uses chapter titles from each book's table of contents, so a chapter with a generic title may be missed.
capabilities: Search books by topic, title, author or ISBN
Check current edition, price in BRL and availability
Map a course syllabus to books and chapters
List subject areas, series, languages and formats
defaultPrompt: Does Blucher have a strength of materials textbook for undergraduates?
Is ISBN 9788521213130 the current edition? If not, which one replaces it?
Suggest Blucher books for: laws of thermodynamics; power and refrigeration cycles; psychrometrics and air conditioning.

positive.description: Find books by topic (English prompt, Portuguese catalog)
positive.prompt: Does Blucher have a strength of materials textbook for undergraduates?
positive.tools_triggered: buscar_livros, or search followed by fetch for book details
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Blucher books led by 'Resistência dos materiais' (4th edition, ISBN 9788521212300), each with current edition, price in BRL, availability and the link to its page on www.blucher.com.br.

positive.description: Current edition and price of a known title
positive.prompt: Qual é a edição atual de Concreto armado eu te amo e quanto custa?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the current edition of Vol. 1 is the 10th (ISBN 9788521218593), gives its price in BRL as shown on the website and links to the book page; it may also mention Vol. 2 and the edition for architects.

positive.description: Old ISBN replaced by a newer edition
positive.prompt: Is ISBN 9788521213130 the current edition? If not, which one replaces it?
positive.expected_behavior: Says ISBN 9788521213130 is the 9th edition of 'Concreto armado eu te amo' Vol. 1 and is not the current edition, and points to the 10th edition, ISBN 9788521218593, with its book page link.

positive.prompt: Suggest Blucher books for this syllabus: first and second laws of thermodynamics; power and refrigeration cycles; ideal gas mixtures; psychrometrics and air conditioning.
positive.expected_behavior: For each of the four topics, suggests Blucher books and, where the table of contents allows, the matching chapter (for example 'Fundamentos e aplicações da psicrometria' for psychrometrics); names the core books and flags suggestions that are out of catalog.

positive.prompt: Which subject areas and book series are in the Blucher catalog?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists subject areas with book counts (for example Engenharias, Psicanálise, Ciências Humanas, Ciências), the series, the languages and the formats in the catalog.

negative.description: Purchase and payment: the plugin has no purchase or payment tool and handles no payment data. Expected: it does not try to buy or ask for card data; at most it gives the book page link on www.blucher.com.br, where the user can buy.
negative.prompt: Buy Concreto armado eu te amo for me and pay with my credit card.

negative.description: Full text of a copyrighted book: the plugin returns only public catalog data, never a book's content. Expected: it declines and offers the book page (a free full-text link exists only for books flagged as open access).
negative.prompt: Send me the full PDF of the book Resistência dos materiais.

negative.description: Personal contact data: the catalog has no author contact data. Expected: it says this is not available, does not guess, and may point to the publisher's support page.
negative.prompt: What is the personal e-mail and phone number of the author Manoel Henrique Campos Botelho?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, take payments or start a checkout. Book records show the price listed on www.blucher.com.br and link to the book's product page on Blucher's own website, never to a cart or checkout page. E-books are listed for information only, with no link to any store.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read-only, no sign-in: search Editora Blucher's catalog (buscar_livros, search), full book records with current edition, price and availability (obter_livro, fetch), syllabus-to-books mapping (recomendar_para_ementa) and catalog facets (catalogo_facetas).

pt-BR.subtitle: Busca no catálogo da Blucher
pt-BR.description:
O Catálogo Blucher conecta o ChatGPT ao catálogo da Editora Blucher, editora brasileira de livros técnicos, científicos e acadêmicos (engenharias, psicanálise, ciências, matemática, design e humanas). Em vez de adivinhar ou repetir dados velhos, o ChatGPT consulta os livros no catálogo da própria editora.

O que dá para fazer:
- Achar livros da Blucher por tema, título, autor ou ISBN, em português ou inglês, mesmo com erro de digitação.
- Ver a edição atual de um livro, o preço em reais, a disponibilidade no site, a sinopse, o sumário e os capítulos.
- Saber se um ISBN é de uma edição antiga e qual edição a substituiu.
- Transformar a ementa de uma disciplina em bibliografia: os livros e capítulos de cada tópico, os livros do núcleo e os tópicos que o catálogo não cobre.
- Ver as áreas, coleções, idiomas e formatos do catálogo.

Para quem: alunos, professores e coordenadores que montam bibliografias, bibliotecários, livreiros e leitores à procura de títulos da Blucher.

Como funciona: só leitura e sem login. Os dados são os mesmos das páginas dos livros em www.blucher.com.br, atualizados todo dia. Cada resposta traz o link da página do livro no site da Blucher.

Limites: cobre só o catálogo da Editora Blucher, quase todo em português. Não vende livros, não recebe pagamento nem faz pedido; preço e disponibilidade do site valem na compra, que acontece só no site. E-books são vendidos em lojas digitais de terceiros, para as quais o plugin não dá link. Livros de acesso aberto trazem o link do texto integral em acesso aberto. A ementa é casada pelos títulos dos capítulos no sumário de cada livro, então um capítulo de título genérico pode escapar.
